name: projeto-automacao-certiqa
description: Projeto de testes automatizados com Cypress e Cucumber (BDD) para o CertiQA

scripts.test:login: node scripts/guard-stage.mjs login && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/features/login.feature
scripts.test:cadastro: node scripts/guard-stage.mjs cadastro && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/features/cadastro.feature
scripts.test:fases: node scripts/guard-stage.mjs fases && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/features/exames_fase.feature
scripts.test:final: node scripts/guard-stage.mjs final && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/features/exame_final.feature
